research_boundary: Engineering implementation, technical verification, UI/API availability and DATA collection are not equivalent to scientific EVID. Scientific maturity is tracked independently through registered questions, frozen protocols, source-bound DATA, human-reviewed EVID, independent replication and attribution. No stage score establishes AGI, consciousness, sentience or biological equivalence.
note: Alpha.5 contains the first complete research-driven experiment cycle through persisted DATA. CL-003 was executed exactly once under its frozen authorization and yielded H1_negative_H2_negative while C3 showed non-random semantic structure. The result remains DATA pending human review; no automatic EVID promotion occurred. Publication edition 1.8 reorganizes and extends the scientific work without changing that evidence status.
